title: Happiness Is a Problem
coreMove: A good life is built by choosing better problems, then engaging them honestly instead of chasing comfort as if pain can be retired.

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether comfort hides a meaningful problem
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Prince Siddhartha to show comfort failing as a life answer
Use Disappointment Panda to make bad news useful

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether escape is mistaken for healing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the Buddha middle path to separate rest from avoidance
Treat emotion as a signal rather than a sacred verdict
Use Disappointment Panda as the messenger for a needed household truth

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether pain is selected or merely endured
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show chosen struggle creating agency without romanticizing pain
